items.title: Digital Omnibus on AI published in the Official Journal — Reg. (EU) 2026/1744, in force 27 July 2026
items.summary: The long-open OJ question is resolved: the AI-specific Digital Omnibus was published 24 July 2026 as Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 and entered into force 27 July, settling the amended AI Act deadline dates.

items.title: Commission adopts final Guidelines on AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations
items.summary: The Commission adopted the final Article 50 transparency guidelines on 20 July 2026, under two weeks before those obligations start applying on 2 August 2026.

items.title: EDPB common template for personal data breach notification (Art. 33)
items.summary: EDPB's draft common Art. 33 breach-notification template (~120 fields, seven sections) is in public consultation until 5 August 2026.
